029e68c03e446725.abstract_zh: This study investigated the hot deformation behavior of a novel ultra-low carbon high-strength stainless steel through single-pass isothermal hot compression tests using a Gleeble-3800 thermomechanical simulator. The hot deformation behavior were examined under deformation temperatures ranging from 900 to 1150 °C, true strains of 0.2 to 0.8, and strain rates of 0.01 to 10 s−1. The differences in recrystallization mechanisms under various strain rates were analyzed. Based on the Dynamic Materials Model (DMM) theory, hot processing maps at true strains of 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 were constructed. And the applicability of the Prasad and Murty instability criteria to this new steel was compared. The results indicate that different recrystallization mechanisms operate at different strain rates. Compared to the commonly used Prasad criterion, the Murty instability criterion aligns better with the experimental observations for this steel. The optimal hot processing window for this new steel is identified as a temperature range of 1100–1150 °C with strain rates of 0.1–1 s−1 and 10 s−1, which is consistent with the microstructure of the deformed specimens. This work offers fundamental insights into the microstructural evolution, which is essential for optimizing the hot-working properties of next-generation high-strength stainless steels.

12c1f7a7aaae613e.abstract_zh: Abstract Dual-phase Mg–Li alloys display interesting mechanical properties, including an unusual increase in ductility at low strain rates due to grain refinement. The effects of grain size, testing temperature and strain rate on the flow stress of an Mg-8wt.% Li alloy processed by high-pressure torsion were investigated through mechanical tests at low strain rates and through machine learning algorithms trained on data in the literature. The data are also compared to the deformation mechanism of grain boundary sliding. The experimental results and creep analyses show a high strain rate sensitivity and ductility and a low activation energy in the material, suggesting the dominance of thermal activated deformation mechanisms. The mechanism of grain boundary sliding is able to predict the trends revealed by experiments, while machine learning models suggest the temperature as the most significant parameter in flow stress. The ability of the black-box and white-box machine learning algorithms to make predictions and errors of models is discussed.

138995c40811d737.abstract_zh: 三重周期性最小曲面（TPMS）结构在轻量化弹道装甲方面具有显著潜力。与以往准静态或低速研究不同，本文明确针对终端弹道领域和穿孔形态进行研究。通过Abaqus/Explicit软件，评估了三种Ti6Al4V TPMS夹层结构（Diamond、Gyroid、Primitive）在7.62 mm穿甲弹以830 m/s速度冲击下的弹道性能。通过结合调谐的壳基全尺寸结构方法与Johnson-Cook损伤演化模型，成功消除了严重单元畸变不稳定性。Diamond拓扑结构表现出最高的弹道效率，在10%相对密度下实现了最优的比能吸收（SEA）为118.27 J/g。该结构调谐方法相比等尺寸的单块RHA钢，核心质量减少了94.3%，同时消除了95%的初始动能。此外，Diamond和Gyroid结构的曲折曲率迫使高度局部化的失效区域，避免了Primitive拓扑结构中观察到的灾难性宏观断裂。这些发现为设计可扩展、重量优化的TPMS弹道屏蔽结构提供了坚实框架，适用于下一代战斗车辆和航空航天应用。

16dfc0f194590a3d.abstract_zh: Abstract 由于焊接引起的残余应力局部化，界面Al-rich金属间化合物（IMCs）的固有脆性仍然是Fe-Al基轻质结构接头可靠性的主要障碍。在此，提出了一种结合晶格重构与位错再捕获的两步策略，以提高异质Al/钢接头中η-Fe2Al5的室温断裂韧性。低温退火促进了η-Fe2Al5晶格的快速重构并缓解长程残余应力，而随后的水淬处理则有助于分散孤立位错的再捕获。处理后的接头拉伸强度达到约258.6 MPa，比加工状态提高了约80.3%，同时η-Fe2Al5承载层的断裂韧性提高了约70%。原位X射线衍射和第一性原理计算揭示了局部压缩应变加速逆共析转变，通过β0相关的转变应变提供了额外的位错网络解耦和应力释放驱动力。保留的η-Fe2Al5/β0界面和再捕获的孤立位错进一步促进η-Fe2Al5的局部应变适应，而裂纹偏转、钝化和桥接则耗散断裂能，这一结论由分子动力学模拟支持。这些结果表明，通过协调残余应力和位错功能性的调控，可以为异质金属接头中的断裂受限IMC承载界面提供一种潜在的改进策略。

22d6a9879348bc5a.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，分析了一种特定类型的粘弹性-塑性本构关系。详细讨论了有限元（FE）实现方法，并推导了一致切线算子。研究了当前模型形式捕捉聚合物材料大应变和应变率依赖响应的能力。发现采用Jemio lo和Lopez-Pamies提出的存储能量函数的粘弹性-塑性模型，能够准确捕捉材料在广泛应变范围和变形速率下的行为。该模型的材料参数已在三种不同的聚合物材料中进行了识别。开发了一个UMAT（用户材料）子程序，使得可以在非商业有限元程序CalculiX中使用该模型类别。

22dc590382a46639.abstract_zh: 基于金属薄板的缺口滚压和锤锻工艺链的创新生产流程展现出巨大潜力，但需要进一步分析工艺步骤之间的相互作用以实现基础工艺理解和设计。鉴于其高度变异性，基于模拟的分析提供了一种可行方法，要求一个足够精确的损伤模型来预测缺口薄板在循环弯曲载荷下的材料失效。通常，损伤模型的材料参数是通过反向标定试验确定的，忽略了其物理意义。经过进一步标定后，结果表明没有纯材料依赖的参数，而是工艺依赖的参数。除了传统方法外，考虑到Lemaitre和GISSMO损伤模型，本文引入了一种基于工艺本身的Lemaitre损伤参数反向识别方法，接受没有纯材料参数和广泛适用模型的保留。传统方法和基于工艺的参数识别方法均应用于循环弯曲的冲压DP600线材。通过比较模拟与实验的扭矩曲线，评估结果显示基于工艺的Lemaitre模型由于具有相似的高应力三轴度而达到良好一致性。而传统确定的GISSMO损伤模型和基于拉伸试验的Lemaitre模型则表现出显著偏差。通过将缺口拉伸试验作为参考，传统确定的Lemaitre模型一致性可得到改善，但其应力三轴度状态仍不同。然而，基于工艺的方法仍证明更为有效，因为它在工程应用中针对目标建模所需的实验工作量更少。

23ba278e041fde2a.abstract_zh: This study proposes a plasticity framework for describing anisotropic hardening and flow direction evolution, which employs data-driven concepts to enhance the traditional von Mises plasticity framework. The approach is an alternative to advanced anisotropic phenomenological plasticity models. On one hand, it incorporates all available data within the experimentally investigated loading path domain into the constitutive plastic response, unlike the traditional models which only use a limited part of the data. On the other hand, it defaults to standard isotropic J2 plastic flow outside of the investigated domain, without making unbased extrapolations of the plastic flow direction far into the untested loading paths. The hardening response is represented using an artificial neural network trained on stress–strain data obtained from different loading directions. Simultaneously, a plastic flow corrector reproduces the experimentally measured r-value evolution. The performance of proposed framework was assessed through finite element simulations of tensile specimens and compared against a conventional Voce hardening model calibrated using a single material orientation. The best agreement with experiments is achieved before the onset of necking, while larger deviations occur under the complex stress states that develop during post-necking deformation. The study demonstrates a thermodynamically admissible framework for modeling highly anisotropic plastic deformation.

2c83ea754a21d39d.abstract_zh: 摘要 实验室测试与数值分析的协同是断裂力学领域的重要前沿。本文研究了一个非对齐预裂纹狗骨试样在EN AW-6060铝合金中的数值-实验对比。该研究的核心思想是展示一个脆性断裂相场模型，特别是第四阶AT2公式，在应用于延性断裂问题时，无需显式考虑塑性耗散即可提供物理上有意义且保守的预测。该研究旨在实现实验与模拟在裂纹模式（定性）和峰值反应力（定量）上的一致，同时评估关键相场参数（包括断裂韧性与内部长度）对整体响应的影响。结果表明，脆性模型的峰值载荷预测与实验测量值的误差在3.5%以内，并成功再现了实验观察到的裂纹模式，支持其在工程应用中作为保守设计工具的使用

2e4897b9498c0519.abstract_zh: • 揭示Mg-Gd-Y合金在不同温度、加载方向和应力状态下的塑性行为。• 开发一个结合温度变量的Swift-Voce模型，以描述温度依赖性塑性行为。• 表征塑性应变下温度依赖性各向异性不对称屈服行为的演变。• 通过提出的A-Yoon2014+SVT模型捕捉不同温度下的三点弯曲变形行为。本工作旨在揭示和模拟Mg-Gd-Y合金在不同温度下各向异性不对称屈服行为的演变。试验在25∼300 °C范围内进行，包括单轴拉伸和压缩。随着温度升高，强度非线性下降。当温度低于200 °C时，热软化效应不显著，但高于250 °C时强度急剧下降。拉伸-压缩不对称性和各向异性被观察到与应变和温度强非线性相关。温度效应被纳入结合Swift-Voce (SVT) 模型中，以更准确地预测温度依赖性应变硬化行为，其精度高于传统Johnson-Cook和Zerilli-Armstrong方程。建立了分析Yoon2014 (A-Yoon2014) 屈服函数，以捕捉应变和温度下的各向异性不对称行为演变。所提出的A-Yoon2014+SVT模型的预测力-行程曲线比原始Yoon2014+SVT模型的数值结果更接近三点弯曲试验结果。鉴于其用户友好性和在模拟温度依赖性各向异性不对称硬化行为方面的高精度，该A-Yoon2014+SVT模型建议用于六方密堆积金属塑性成形过程的数值模拟。

346cb8dbe0981074.abstract_zh: 准确预测增材制造（AM）316L不锈钢在高温和高应变率下的动态流动应力对于服务安全评估和成形工艺优化至关重要。为克服传统经验本构模型的有限精度和纯数据驱动模型在小数据集下的弱泛化能力，本文开发了一种Johnson–Cook指导的PCA-MLP残差学习模型（JC-PCA-MLP）。以Johnson–Cook模型作为物理基础，主成分分析（PCA）用于降低实验测量与JC预测之间残差应力的维度。多层感知机（MLP）预测PCA残差系数，以重构完整的应力-应变曲线。该模型在不同温度和高应变率下的AM 316L不锈钢动态压缩数据上进行了验证，使用未见过的中间温度（272°C和450°C）进行测试。模型在272°C和450°C下分别实现了平均R²为0.9306和0.9538，平均绝对相对误差（AARE）为1.97%和1.63%，最小R²分别为0.8779和0.8909。与JC、MLP和PCA-MLP模型相比，JC-PCA-MLP模型在预测精度和稳定性方面表现更优。本工作提供了一种高效的物理信息引导数据驱动策略，用于增材制造316L不锈钢的动态本构建模。

37d6a579e44df0f1.abstract_zh: The article deals with the effect of stress triaxiality on the inelastic deformation behavior of aluminum alloys. The proposed continuum model takes into account stress triaxiality dependence of the yield condition as well as of the damage criterion and the fracture condition with different branches corresponding to various damage and failure modes depending on the stress triaxiality and the Lode parameter. Results of numerical cell simulations on the microscale are presented and corresponding identification of micromechanically motivated material parameters is discussed. Furthermore, numerical results of three-dimensional macromechanical finite element analyses are compared with experimental data obtained from smooth and pre-notched tension specimens. The analyses allow verification of the continuum model and identification of further material parameters.
37d6a579e44df0f1.title_zh: 基于不同微机制的延性损伤与断裂行为建模
37d6a579e44df0f1.tldr: 对铝合金，研究应力三轴度对其非弹性变形行为的影响，建立考虑不同微机制的连续损伤模型。

3c6122ecf5654c75.abstract_zh: Fully coupled ductile damage model considering strength-differential (SD) effect is proposed for simulation of metal forming processes for Ti-6Al-4V. The developed constitutive equations are based on non-associative plasticity theory under thermodynamically-consistent framework. The third stress invariant is added to Hill48 criterion to capture the SD effect. Lode angle-dependent enhanced fully coupled damage model is proposed to account for the loading path sensitivity on ductile damage initiation and growth. A detailed material parameters identification procedure is presented. The proposed model is implemented into the FE code Abaqus/Explicit through user defined subroutine VUMAT. The numerically predicted results obtained with the proposed model are compared to experimental data of Ti-6Al-4V and good agreement is observed.
3c6122ecf5654c75.title_zh: 考虑Lode角依赖性的增强CDM模型用于钛合金Ti-6Al-4V室温韧性断裂预测
3c6122ecf5654c75.tldr: 提出一种考虑Lode角依赖性的增强CDM模型，用于钛合金Ti-6Al-4V的室温韧性断裂预测，与实验数据吻合良好。

3e3d6b6837d2350b.title_zh: 开环和闭环原位工艺控制对L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响
3e3d6b6837d2350b.tldr: 分析开环和闭环原位工艺控制对L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响。

40e16bc50ce9dcc1.abstract_zh: ABSTRACT 尽管面心立方高熵合金（HEAs）已受到广泛关注和深入研究，但大多数现有研究集中在单一温度或应变率条件下，缺乏对极端热机械耦合环境下变形机制的系统研究。本工作中，制备了一种含有超细L1 2析出相和η相的CoCrFeNiTi 0.2 HEA，并在宽温度范围（293–1273 K）和应变率范围（0.001–5000 s −1 ）下进行了压缩试验，随后系统表征了相应的微观结构演变。结果表明，在不同应变率下该合金表现出逆热软化行为。在流动应力–温度曲线中观察到异常的双峰应力峰值，分别由第三类应变时效和变形过程中L1 2析出相的原位粗化引起，导致逆热软化行为。与第三类应变时效相关的应力峰值出现在不同应变率下，并随应变率增加向更高温度偏移。Ti原子作为溶质原子，形成溶质气氛并有效钉扎移动位错。相比之下，由L1 2析出相原位粗化引起的应力峰值对应变率几乎不敏感。对多种变形机制——包括位错滑移、孪生、堆垛层错介导塑性以及动态再结晶——在温度和应变率下的依赖性进行了深入研究。最后，构建了一个涵盖整个研究温度和应变率范围的变形机制示意图。本研究阐明了CoCrFeNiTi 0.2 HEA在极端环境下的变形机制，为航空航天、武器等领域的高性能HEA设计和应用提供了重要的理论基础和实验支持。
40e16bc50ce9dcc1.title_zh: 高熵合金在不同应变率下的逆热软化行为
40e16bc50ce9dcc1.tldr: 研究CoCrFeNiTi 0.2高熵合金在极端热机械耦合环境下的变形机制，发现其在不同应变率下表现出逆热软化行为。

47ff33d61597715d.abstract_zh: 金属材料的延性断裂涉及显著的塑性变形、剪切局部化、损伤累积和最终裂纹传播——这些现象在组合时对计算提出了重大挑战。本文提出一种任意阶虚拟元素方法（VEM），用于延性断裂模拟，采用四阶相场模型与速率相关塑性相结合。四阶相场正则化提供了更清晰的裂纹表示和更高的精度，但需要𝐶 1连续的元素，这给数值实现带来复杂性。通过采用𝐻 2-符合的VEM处理四阶相场方程，以及𝐻 1-符合的VEM处理动量平衡方程，解决了这一挑战。塑性响应采用Bodner–Partom粘塑性本构模型进行建模，并引入塑性退化函数，将损伤演化与塑性变形耦合。数值实例展示了该框架模拟复杂延性断裂现象的能力，包括剪切带形成、塑性变形区域裂纹成核以及动态裂纹传播。结果表明，该框架是一种强大的计算工具，能够使用多边形元素模拟延性断裂过程。
47ff33d61597715d.title_zh: 用于高阶相场模拟的任意阶虚拟元素方法
47ff33d61597715d.tldr: 针对金属材料的延性断裂，采用任意阶虚拟元素方法结合四阶相场模型与速率相关塑性，实现复杂断裂现象的模拟。

48f985427a996aad.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的方法用于识别板料成形本构模型参数。该方法基于机器学习模型与Levenberg-Marquardt优化算法的结合，并应用于Swift硬化定律和CPB06屈服准则参数的识别。所提出的方法利用了十字形双向拉伸试验结果数据，旨在克服使用CPB06屈服准则表征材料时的一些固有挑战。通过比较测试材料的应力-应变曲线和屈服面，获得的预测性能总体令人满意，突显了所提出方法的潜力。
48f985427a996aad.title_zh: 通过分类和回归机器学习算法联合应用识别板料成形本构模型的离散和连续参数
48f985427a996aad.tldr: 利用机器学习和Levenberg-Marquardt优化算法识别Swift硬化定律和CPB06屈服准则参数，结果与实验数据吻合良好。

4a047457fccd306b.abstract_zh: 随着氢管道的发展，氢脆已成为影响管道钢安全服役的关键问题。然而，氢诱导韧性-脆性转变的临界氢浓度及其与晶粒尺寸的关系仍不清楚。通过分子动力学模拟，研究了氢浓度和晶粒尺寸对多晶α-Fe氢诱导韧性-脆性转变的影响，分析了氢扩散、位错发射和断裂演化过程。结果表明，随着氢浓度增加，氢原子优先沿晶界扩散，并逐渐达到分离饱和，导致机械性能持续退化。细晶粒和粗晶粒模型的初始断裂应变均下降超过40%，断裂能下降超过50%。裂纹表面面积分别增加2.48倍和1.86倍，表明细晶粒模型对氢更为敏感。当晶界氢浓度约为7–9%时，抑制的晶界位错发射触发了从塑性变形到脆性晶间断裂的转变，标志着氢诱导韧性-脆性转变的开始。建立了晶粒尺寸与晶界原子分数之间的定量关系，以预测该转变的临界氢浓度。本研究揭示了氢浓度在调节位错发射和晶间断裂中的作用，为氢脆评估和管道材料设计提供了见解。
4a047457fccd306b.title_zh: 不同氢浓度和晶粒尺寸下多晶α-Fe中氢诱导韧性-脆性转变的原子尺度研究
4a047457fccd306b.tldr: 通过分子动力学模拟研究不同氢浓度和晶粒尺寸对多晶α-Fe氢诱导韧性-脆性转变的影响。

4a2374ce1d4e57e7.abstract_zh: 单距离相位恢复技术被应用于对比增强成像，以观察具有仅1.4%密度差的铁素体/马氏体双相微观结构。每张高分辨率吸收对比图像与对应的相位对比图像进行配准，以分析损伤演化行为。通过追踪微孔洞在拉伸过程中的发展及其成核位置，确定了每个微孔洞的成核载荷步骤。在多个成核位点，如铁素体内部、马氏体内部和铁素体/马氏体界面，观察到微孔洞在相对较早阶段的提前损伤成核；然而，这些微孔洞的后续生长相对缓慢。另一方面，由于马氏体裂纹在最大载荷后产生的微孔洞随后表现出快速生长。马氏体裂纹诱导的损伤演化主要沿附近的铁素体/马氏体界面以及马氏体与铁素体晶界交界处发生。值得注意的是，源自马氏体裂纹的微孔洞在宏观拉伸下表现出以剪切为主的生长特征，而其他成核位点的微孔洞则表现出传统的三轴应力主导的生长特征。结论是，塑性断裂主要由位于形态特征马氏体颗粒上的微孔洞的显著生长力所主导。
4a2374ce1d4e57e7.title_zh: 利用相位和吸收对比断层扫描研究双相钢的损伤微观机制
4a2374ce1d4e57e7.tldr: 对双相钢材料，采用相位和吸收对比断层扫描技术，分析微孔洞损伤演化行为，发现微孔洞生长模式与形貌特征的马氏体颗粒有关。

4bb3d89761846386.title_zh: 硬化定律的颈缩后预测对铝板理论成形极限曲线的影响研究

552e124545ec76a5.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，通过结合经典塑性理论与神经网络算法，成功开发了用于预测AA7075-T6各向异性力学行为的机器学习模型。首先，基于四阶线性不变量变换构建了一个包含强度不对称性和取向依赖性的屈服准则，并通过返回映射和隐式积分方案实现了应力更新算法。随后，建立了一个包含拉伸、压缩和剪切试验在多个取向下的实验数据集，以及通过额外应变路径生成的理论数据集，用于训练一个遗传算法优化的双隐藏层神经网络。塑性阶段评估表明，在等双轴路径下，机器学习模型预测的应力-应变曲线相对于本构实现的RMSE值分别为31.87 MPa和39.24 MPa。值得注意的是，等双轴加载下的应力-应变响应代表了一个额外的预测案例。训练后的模型在与拉伸、压缩和剪切实验数据的比较中表现出良好的预测性能，并能够再现由经典本构模型推导出的理论应力路径。该方法结合了传统本构建模的物理可解释性和数据驱动方法的高效性，为高效预测金属材料在复杂应力状态下的各向异性力学响应提供了可行的解决方案。
552e124545ec76a5.title_zh: 基于各向异性弹塑性本构理论的AA7075-T6机器学习模型
552e124545ec76a5.tldr: 结合经典塑性理论与神经网络算法，开发了用于预测AA7075-T6各向异性力学行为的机器学习模型。

559228ff24cf0761.abstract_zh: Accurate constitutive modeling of hot deformation characteristics is essential for the development of thermomechanical procedures for advanced structural alloys. Conventional Arrhenius-type and empirical models frequently find it challenging to effectively depict the combined influences of strain hardening, dynamic recovery (DRV), and dynamic recrystallization (DRX) across extensive processing intervals. This research uses two Stacked Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks (STAR-PINNs) to predict the hot-deformation characteristics of a Mo-rich α + β titanium alloy (Ti–6Al–4Mo–1V–0.1Si). The Improved STAR-PINN integrates thermomechanical constitutive restrictions, while the DRX-Aware STAR-PINN utilizes a dual-output framework that incorporates recrystallization kinetics through a trainable JMAK–Avrami model. Both models utilize a common residual encoder that is trained on empirical flow-stress data collected at temperatures ranging from 800 to 1050 °C and strain rates between 0.01 and 10 s⁻¹ . Constraints informed by physics that enforce thermal softening, strain-rate sensitivity, strain hardening, and post-peak softening are applied via automatic differentiation. The DRX-Aware model also includes JMAK–Avrami regularization featuring learnable, constrained kinetic parameters k and n, DRX saturation limits, Arrhenius-based consistency, and latent-feature integration connecting the estimated DRX fraction to the stress output. The DRX-Aware STAR-PINN obtained RMSE = 11.62 MPa, MAE = 4.73 MPa, and R² = 0.9852 on the test set reserved for validation, along with a five-fold cross-validated RMSE of 12.74 ± 0.38 MPa. The learned JMAK parameters converged to k = 2.03 and n = 1.99 , remaining close to the conventional values while being inferred directly from the data. The model effectively mirrored flow curves influenced by temperature, DRX development, and Zener–Hollomon correlations under interpolation scenarios while preserving physically coherent constitutive behavior. These findings illustrate that physics-informed deep learning delivers a precise and understandable structure for constitutive modeling, presenting a viable approach for sophisticated process modeling of hot-deformed titanium alloys.
559228ff24cf0761.title_zh: 基于物理信息残差深度学习的Mo-rich α + β钛合金热变形与动态再结晶本构建模
559228ff24cf0761.tldr: 利用物理信息残差深度学习模型预测Mo-rich α + β钛合金在热变形和动态再结晶过程中的本构行为。

5662750f24c0e14d.abstract_zh: This work examines the high-rate compression response of 34CrNi3MoA alloy steel by means of SHPB tests carried out at 25 °C, 200 °C, 400 °C and 600 °C, with strain rates ranging from 1000 to 4600 s⁻¹. The experimental curves indicate rate strengthening, thermal softening and a local stress increase related to dynamic strain aging in a specific temperature rate interval. When the conventional Johnson-Cook model was calibrated with the same data set, the average relative error reached 20.63%, showing that the separable strain, rate and temperature terms were insufficient for this material. To improve the description, the model was revised by introducing a rate-dependent thermal-softening exponent, a two dimensional Gaussian function for the dynamic-strain-aging peak and a hardening coefficient coupled with both temperature and strain rate. The revised model reduced the average relative error to 2.88% and gave a closer representation of the measured curves within the tested range. The proposed equation is therefore recommended as an interpolation model for 1000-4600 s⁻¹ and 25-600 °C; application beyond this domain still requires further calibration and uncertainty evaluation.

62adebe648a03640.abstract_zh: 准确的塑性建模在提高制造效率和产品质量方面起着重要作用。目前已有多种非对称屈服准则被开发，但大多数准则在捕捉剪切和近平面应变拉伸下的屈服行为方面存在局限。为克服这些局限，准确模拟金属板在各种应力状态下的屈服行为以及在单轴拉伸和压缩下的各向异性响应，开发了一个结合应力状态偶函数与各向异性非对称屈服函数的综合框架。在此框架下，提出了一种扩展的Yoon2014准则。该扩展准则用于描述AZ31、AA5754、AA2A12和DP980板的初始屈服轨迹，以及AA2A12和QP1180板的演化屈服轨迹。此外，将扩展准则与Hill48塑性势函数结合，在数值模拟中预测A5052板在圆柱杯拉深试验中的塑性行为。扩展模型的预测结果与实验数据吻合良好。对五种研究板的应用表明，该准则能够有效表征不同方向下金属板在单轴拉伸和压缩、等双轴拉伸和等双轴压缩（经验估计）以及近平面应变拉伸和剪切下的初始屈服行为和硬化响应。杯拉深模拟进一步表明，该模型结合适当的塑性势函数可有效预测金属板在成形过程中的塑性行为。

727a35461a5f3794.abstract_zh: Abstract Auxetic lattices are an important part in the development of smart metamaterials suitable for intelligent applications in high strain-rate dynamics. In this work, three types of auxetic lattices (missing-rib, two- and three-dimensional re-entrant honeycomb) additively manufactured from 316L stainless steel using the LPBF method were subjected to a combined experimental and numerical investigation of their compressive response under quasi-static conditions and during dynamic impact at nominal strain rates of $$1500{\text {s}^{-1}}$$ and $$3000{\text {s}^{-1}}$$ in an in-house designed SHPB apparatus. All the experiments were instrumented using optical cameras for non-contact deformation tracking to establish deformation fields in the samples and calculate the strain and strain-rate dependent function of Poisson’s ratio. A fully 3D three-bar finite element model of the SHPB apparatus and the studied lattices was developed and implemented in LS-DYNA. Mesh density and discretization type sensitivity studies were carried out together with the experimental calibration of strain-rate dependent bilinear constitutive model representing the material of the 3D printed lattices. Simulated dynamic impacts were performed with the same initial conditions as the experiments and the numerical stress-strain characteristics of the studied samples were calculated from the numerical strain signals using the same mathematical methods used for evaluation of laboratory SHPB experiments. The agreement of the experimental and simulated stress-strain response up to the densification region was studied for all the investigated types of lattices at both dynamic strain rates. To interpret the origin of the discrepancies in the simulated and observed stress-strain response as well as the calculated function of Poisson’s ratio, X-ray computed microtomographical imaging was performed and the assessed differences were attributed to the manufacturing inaccuracies and defects in the samples.
727a35461a5f3794.title_zh: 316L不锈钢增材制造仿生负泊松比晶格的动态压缩响应实验与数值模拟

84634161ed858206.abstract_zh: Efficient calibration of damage-evolution parameters remains a key challenge in semi-coupled fracture modeling of advanced high-strength steels because these parameters are not directly measurable and usually require repeated experiment–simulation iterations. This study develops a semi-coupled damage framework for thin QP980 steel sheets under limited experimental data. The plastic response is described by the Hill48 yield criterion and a modified Swift–Voce hardening law, damage initiation by a Modified Mohr–Coulomb (MMC)-based fracture locus, and post-initiation softening by a continuum damage mechanics (CDM)-based evolution law. A hierarchical calibration strategy is adopted: plasticity and damage-initiation parameters are determined through conventional experiment–simulation procedures, whereas damage-evolution parameters are identified using a genetic algorithm–backpropagation (GA-BP) neural network. A finite element database was constructed from the R5 notched specimen, with parameter ranges selected to cover the observed softening response. The calibrated framework was validated using notched and shear specimens. The GA–BP-calibrated model reproduced experimental force–displacement curves and fracture displacements, with fracture displacement errors within 3.4%. Digital image correlation (DIC) strain-field comparisons further confirmed the predicted localization patterns. The results provide an efficient, physically constrained route for semi-coupled damage-model calibration and fracture assessment of thin QP980 steel sheets.

8ece5a5a1b6ec43c.abstract_zh: Predicting the stress–strain behaviors of additively manufactured materials is crucial for part qualification in additive manufacturing (AM). Conventional physics-based constitutive models of materials have limitations, such as oversimplification of material properties and narrow applicability to limited strain rates, while purely data-driven machine learning (ML) models often lack physical consistency and interpretability. To address these issues, we introduce a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) framework that leverages physical laws in elastic and plastic regions to improve the predictive performance and physical consistency when predicting the stress–strain curves of additively manufactured polymers and metals. A polynomial regression model is first used to predict the yield point based on AM process parameters, and then the stress–strain curves are segmented into elastic and plastic regions using the predicted yield point. Two long short-term memory (LSTM) models are trained to predict the two regions separately. For the elastic region, Hooke’s law is embedded in the LSTM models for both polymers and metals. For the plastic region, Voce hardening law and Hollomon’s law are embedded in the LSTM models for the polymers and metals, respectively. In addition, the PIML framework is implemented by two architectures, including the loss-based and activation-based PIML architectures, where the physical laws are embedded into the loss and activation functions, respectively. The performance of the two PIML architectures is compared with two LSTM-based ML models, three additional ML models, including a ridge polynomial regression model, an artificial neural network, and a transformer, and a physics-based constitutive model. These models are built on experimental data collected from two additively manufactured polymers (i.e., Nylon and carbon fiber-acrylonitrile butadiene styrene) and two additively manufactured metals (i.e., AlSi10Mg and Ti6Al4V). Experimental results demonstrate that two PIML architectures consistently outperform other ML baseline models and the physics-based constitutive model. The segmental predictive model with the activation-based PIML architecture achieves the best overall performance, with the lowest MAPE of 10.46 ± 0.81 %, the lowest MAE of 26.07 ± 2.52 MPa, the lowest RMSE of 29.28 ± 2.83 MPa, and the highest R 2 of 0.82 ± 0.05, indicating superior predictive performance for four different materials.

91831887e9542fc8.abstract_zh: 铁素体-马氏体EP-450钢因其对辐照诱导肿胀的高抗性，广泛用于快中子反应堆燃料组件包裹材料。然而，其在低温高剂量中子辐照下形成的辐射硬化状态可能在后续热暴露过程中演变。本研究考察了从两个BN-350乏燃料组件包裹材料中取样的EP-450钢在约351 °C辐照至61和71 dpa后的热恢复行为。样品在静态氩气中于470 °C退火，累计退火时间分别为10、30和100小时。对两种包裹材料进行了维氏硬度测试，对71 dpa材料进行了微型拉伸试验。初始硬度值相似，分别为356和360 HV0.2，但热响应差异显著：退火100小时后，硬度分别下降了10.2%和17.9%。对于71 dpa材料，0.2%屈服强度从815 MPa下降至752 MPa，总应变和局部应变分别从15.33%增加至17.94%和从8.84%增加至11.45%。这些结果表明，在470 °C下辐照硬化随时间逐渐减弱，并揭示了初始硬度相似的材料可能表现出显著不同的热稳定性。

95e89964e0edc9a7.abstract_zh: 在高温塑性变形过程中，材料流动应力受变形温度、应变速率和应变的共同影响。其准确预测对热加工工艺优化和有限元模拟至关重要。为解决传统应变补偿Arrhenius本构模型在预定义函数形式和残差预测误差方面的局限性，本文基于高温压缩数据，开发了一种基于深度符号优化的修正应变补偿Arrhenius模型（SR-ARH）。该框架采用RNN引导、GP辅助的策略来识别显式的修正因子表达式。运算符集根据高温流动应力演化的非周期性和非线性特征进行约束。基于特征重要性分析，首先开发了SR-ARH-2F模型，使用温度和应变速率作为特征，随后开发了SR-ARH-3F模型，加入应变作为额外特征。SR-ARH-3F模型在整体预测性能上优于SR-ARH-2F模型，因此被选为最终模型。留一条件验证揭示了该模型在未见过的变形条件下具有条件依赖的泛化性能，而应变硬化率分析显示在标定范围内无明显的非物理振荡。与应变补偿Arrhenius模型相比，SR-ARH-3F模型将RMSE降低了3.397-15.574 MPa，AARE降低了3.428-8.177个百分点，同时R值提高了0.00616-0.04747。进一步使用DEFORM-2D进行了高温压缩模拟。通过模拟获得的载荷-位移曲线与实验曲线更接近，对应的载荷AARE相比应变补偿Arrhenius模型降低了0.188-19.099个百分点，证实了所提模型在高温压缩数值模拟中的适用性。

9f737c55ed5964c0.abstract_zh: Abstract A modification of the Lemaitre damage accumulation model that takes into account strain–induced martensitic transformation is proposed for metastable austenitic steels. The influence of the strain–induced martensite, accumulated microdamage and internal stresses on the dynamic Young’s modulus and density of the material was taken into account. Expressions have been obtained for calculating the Young’s modulus of the intact austenite and the change in the effective Young’s modulus due to the relaxation of residual stresses after the first cycles of elastic–plastic deformation. For the first time, the knee point of the fatigue curve between the low–cycle and high–cycle fatigue regions is presented in terms of the intensity of strain induced martensite formation. A comparison of the damage parameter calculated within the proposed model and the classical Lemaitre damage accumulation model was carried out. A method for individual life prediction at the final stage of structure evolution based on acoustic measurement data is proposed.
9f737c55ed5964c0.title_zh: 考虑应变诱导马氏体转变的Lemaitre损伤累积模型修正用于疲劳下的亚稳奥氏体钢

a296a938a3aa7b18.abstract_zh: 本文通过对比终端弹道计算机模拟结果与穿甲弹穿透装甲钢的实验数据，评估了文献中提出的本构模型的充分性。模拟中采用了一种改进的Johnson-Cook模型，通过引入Cockcroft-Latham延性断裂准则而非标准失效模型进行增强。分析包括网格结构以及元素相互作用的算法。通过网格收敛性测试评估了网格密度对模拟结果的影响。基于我们对芯材力学性能的自身实验测试，分析表明需要改进本构模型的校准。

a694bc8b810f65b4.title_zh: 颈缩后硬化行为与等效应力-应变曲线对基于M–K模型的成形极限图精度的影响

a6bd0101d70eeaf0.abstract_zh: Commercially pure titanium grade 2 exhibits a distinct deformation profile: a short strain hardening stage followed by prolonged post-necking ductility, behavior inadequately captured by conventional hardening laws. To address this, a modified coupled plasticity–damage model is proposed to accurately reproduce the stress–strain response of the material. The study systematically investigates ductile failure under variable stress triaxialities and Lode angles using five distinct specimen geometries: dog-bone, notched, two in-plane shear configurations, and hat-shaped compression. A fully coupled ductile damage–plasticity model, explicitly accounting for stress triaxiality and Lode angle, is implemented alongside a non-linear damage evolution law. Three modified Ganjiani, KHPS, and DF2016 failure criteria are studied due to their comparable predictive accuracy. Experimental data are validated through ABAQUS/Explicit simulations using VUSDFLD and VUHARD, demonstrating good agreement in force evolution and fracture strain across all geometries. Digital image correlation further confirms the fidelity of the simulations. The initiation of failure is geometry dependent: for dog-bone and notched specimens, it coincides with the onset of slope reduction post-plateau; for shear, shear-tension, and hat-shaped compression specimens, failure initiates at the onset of hardening, where the slope of the force–displacement curve begins to decrease significantly. These findings provide a robust framework for predicting ductile failure in the material studied under complex loading.
a6bd0101d70eeaf0.title_zh: 纯钛延性断裂中颈缩后软化的作用
a6bd0101d70eeaf0.tldr: 针对纯钛材料，研究颈缩后软化对延性断裂的影响，建立改进的塑性-损伤耦合模型以准确预测其力学行为。

a732a04ebead1bf1.abstract_zh: 金属环网是柔性落石防护网的核心拦截组件，其力学行为的准确表征对整个系统的安全性评估至关重要。为克服现有计算模型在反映环网大变形状态和能量耗散器激活方面的局限性，首先对五种规格的环网（R8至R19，共30个样本）进行了系统的单轴拉伸试验和穿刺试验。结果揭示了两种加载情况下的两阶段变形特征（初始低力拉伸阶段后为刚度硬化快速上升阶段）和并行叠加的承载机制。在此基础上，将实验数据归一化处理，即通过将力除以钢丝数量并进行无量纲化位移，建立了一个统一的分段两阶段本构模型，包含线性拉伸段和幂律硬化段，以描述直至峰值点的响应；拉伸和穿刺情况共享相同的模型形式，仅通过不同的参数（决定系数R2不低于0.97，平均值分别为0.98和0.983）进行区分。随后，使用LS-DYNA建立了整体结构的全尺寸数值模型，其中两侧跨度采用拉伸本构模型，中间冲击跨度采用穿刺本构模型。该模型通过1500 kJ全尺寸冲击试验进行了验证。计算得到的支撑绳力时程、能量耗散器（减压环）的激活状态、最大拦截变形（计算值8.23 m，实测值8.8 m，相对误差约6.5%）以及减压环的能量耗散分布（平均相对误差约5.2%）均与实验结果良好吻合。因此，所提出的两阶段计算模型能够准确反映环网在实际结构中的力和变形状态，并正确描述冲击力的传递和能量耗散器的激活，为柔性落石防护网的精细化设计提供了可靠的理论基础。
a732a04ebead1bf1.title_zh: 金属环网在柔性落石防护网中的两阶段计算模型研究
a732a04ebead1bf1.tldr: 通过实验和模拟建立金属环网的两阶段计算模型，以准确描述其在柔性落石防护网中的力学行为。

a7e656d9d3df97c4.title_zh: 考虑支承摩擦的单边缺口深梁试样断裂参数的有限元校准与机器学习预测
a7e656d9d3df97c4.tldr: 校准考虑支承摩擦的单边缺口深梁试样断裂参数，并利用机器学习进行预测。

a880d3ed2dce67ed.abstract_zh: Transmission casings may undergo time-dependent deformation under sustained thermal and mechanical loading, which cannot be fully characterized by conventional static-strength checks. To evaluate the relative service performance of six AZ80-series magnesium-alloy states in a casing, this study integrates experimental and published data and establishes a unified workflow spanning creep data, constitutive calibration, standard-specimen finite element response, and equivalent-casing assessment. A common transient-steady creep equation is used to describe all six material states, and the constitutive relations calibrated at specimen level are applied directly to the same equivalent casing model. The component responses are compared under consistent computational conditions and assessment criteria. As temperature increases, the casing response shifts from instantaneous load-bearing control toward time-dependent deformation control. Within the 100 h analysis window, C, F, R, and RT5 reach the 5% total-strain threshold under some elevated-temperature conditions, whereas R175T6 and R250T6 remain below this threshold. At 175°C, their maximum total strains are 2.97% and 2.55%, respectively, indicating lower creep-deformation accumulation and better relative deformation stability. From the perspective of creep-deformation control, R175T6 and R250T6 can therefore be considered candidate states for subsequent high-temperature casing assessment. The creep model primarily describes the primary and secondary stages and does not address tertiary-stage damage or creep-rupture life. A complete high-temperature safety assessment of the two T6 states requires additional strength and ductility data.
a880d3ed2dce67ed.title_zh: 使用AZ80镁合金不同状态评估传动壳体的蠕变服务性能：从本构建模到组件响应的统一比较
a880d3ed2dce67ed.tldr: 通过整合实验和文献数据，建立统一流程评估AZ80镁合金不同状态在传动壳体中的蠕变服务性能。

aa39c7ba567f2763.abstract_zh: 金属变形过程中微观结构特征的预测一直是研究重点。已有研究表明，超声振动辅助铆接实验可定量改变铆钉的晶粒尺寸（GS）和几何必要位错（GND）密度。然而，现有微尺度理论模型主要关注总位错密度的预测，且大多数模型适用于纵向超声振动，针对横向超声振动辅助成形过程中晶粒尺寸和几何必要位错密度的定量预测研究较少。因此，本研究聚焦于广泛应用于航空领域的2A10铝合金试样，进行了不同超声振幅下的横向超声振动辅助压缩（TUVAC）试验。基于实验研究，建立了包含几何必要位错密度和晶粒尺寸的多尺度超声本构模型，并开发了VUMAT子程序以预测TUVAC模拟中2A10铝合金的微观结构特征。结果表明，当超声振幅从0 μm增加到21.2 μm时，最大流动应力从509.7 MPa降低至477.4 MPa。与原始试样相比，简单压缩后<111>||ND纤维织构的强度显著降低。在压缩过程中施加横向超声振动时，铜织构持续减弱，而黄铜织构随超声振幅增加逐渐增强。相比之下，S织构和<111>||ND纤维织构则先增加后减少。几何必要位错密度非线性增加，而晶粒尺寸逐渐减小，表明显著的晶粒细化。超声本构模型的预测结果与实验数据进行了比较，结果显示在不同振幅下应力的平均绝对相对误差（AARE）均低于2.2%。对实验与模拟结果的比较分析表明，几何必要位错密度的AARE约为15%，晶粒尺寸的AARE约为12%，而微硬度的AARE低于5%。因此，所提出的本构模型能够准确预测宏观力学行为和微观结构特征，从而为进一步研究超声辅助铆接的微机制和性能提供了坚实的理论基础。
aa39c7ba567f2763.title_zh: 2A10铝合金在横向超声振动辅助压缩下的表征与多尺度本构模型研究
aa39c7ba567f2763.tldr: 通过横向超声振动辅助压缩试验，建立包含几何必要位错密度和晶粒尺寸的多尺度超声本构模型，用于预测2A10铝合金的微观结构特征。

ac53f9dd653934f1.abstract_zh: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) are increasingly transforming Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) workflows by enabling faster design iterations and reducing computational costs. This paper presents the application of Ansys SimAI and Ansys GeomAI in modelling an automotive side impact scenario using high-fidelity data from LS-DYNA simulations. Two AI models are trained on datasets with systematically varied parameters: one encompassing pole impact position and door beam configurations, and another focusing on rocker panel reinforcements. Both models exhibit strong predictive performance, reliably capturing deformation patterns and force-time histories for previously unseen configurations. The datasets are subsequently merged to train a comprehensive surrogate model capable of simultaneously representing variations in pole position, door beam geometry, and rocker reinforcement design, demonstrating robust generalization across a multidimensional design space. To address the emerging bottleneck of geometry creation, GeomAI’s geometry exploration functionality is employed to generate new rocker reinforcement geometries from existing ones, which are then rapidly validated using the pre-trained surrogate model. The results confirm that LS-DYNA simulations can be leveraged effectively to build AI models that dramatically reduce design exploration time. With SimAI and GeomAI in the loop, CAE workflows can evolve from simulation-driven design toward AI-augmented autonomous engineering, where geometry generation, simulation, validation, and optimization converge into an intelligent closed loop.
ac53f9dd653934f1.title_zh: 超越模拟：人工智能在未来碰撞研究中的作用
ac53f9dd653934f1.tldr: 利用Ansys SimAI和GeomAI对汽车侧面碰撞场景建模，通过高保真LS-DYNA数据训练AI模型，显著减少设计探索时间。

af201ae12d18a896.abstract_zh: 我们呈现了一项定量、多尺度、四维研究，探讨再结晶AA2198-T851合金板在“拉伸到剪切”载荷路径变化过程中延性损伤的演化。在拉伸下产生显著的应变和损伤，其随后在剪切下的演化被量化。通过基于同步辐射的原位三维X射线层析技术表征损伤机制，并结合相关表面成像进行补充。通过投影数字图像相关测量的中尺度应变场，经模拟验证后，指导了样本内部感兴趣区域的选择及其边界条件。损伤特征要么与晶粒相关，要么由金属间粒子引起。晶粒相关的损伤在剪切下仅表现出中等程度的演化，体积增加约1.5倍，而金属间粒子引起的空洞则表现出显著的生长，体积增加可达6倍。为了阐明其内在机制，利用三维有限元建模，结合实验观测的粒子-空洞簇和测量的边界条件进行分析。模拟再现了通过刚性金属间粒子相关的空洞锁定机制驱动的强烈剪切诱导空洞生长。在没有这些粒子的情况下，模拟预测剪切下的空洞生长显著减少，证实了金属间粒子在剪切驱动损伤演化中的关键作用。
af201ae12d18a896.title_zh: 剪切载荷下粒子诱导空洞生长的表征：通过三维X射线层析和有限元建模揭示
af201ae12d18a896.tldr: 通过三维X射线层析和有限元建模，研究再结晶AA2198-T851合金板在拉伸到剪切载荷路径变化下的粒子诱导空洞生长机制。

af4e4614f85209ca.abstract_zh: 摘要 血栓在机械取栓过程中发生碎片化可能导致远端栓塞，但其断裂机制因血栓经历大变形、纤维网络重排和成分依赖的力学响应而难以预测。本研究旨在开发一个连续断裂框架，用于分析血栓裂纹起始与扩展，同时考虑纤维网络各向异性随变形的演化。通过耦合超弹性基体响应、纤维诱导的各向异性增强、成分依赖的本构缩放、损伤退化和应变驱动的纤维重排定律，建立了有限变形各向异性相场断裂模型。主要创新点在于将优选纤维方向视为一个随变形演化的内部结构变量，其趋向于局部最大主应变方向，并影响各向异性储存能量和裂纹驱动历史场。该模型通过Abaqus的交错用户定义材料-用户定义单元程序实现。本构参数通过纤维凝胶拉伸数据进行标定，断裂响应与带缺口单轴断裂实验进行对比，使用实验驱动的断裂韧性值。此外，进行了额外的数值参数研究，以考察纤维分散性、重排参数和加载配置对断裂行为的影响。结果表明，纤维重排和分散性显著影响力-位移响应、损伤局部化和裂纹扩展路径。所提出的框架为研究大变形下的血栓断裂提供了基础，并可能支持未来涉及流体迁移、血管约束和血栓-器械相互作用的模型扩展。

b084c95a39f29a80.abstract_zh: Machining titanium alloys such as Ti6Al4V is challenging due to their low thermal conductivity, high strength, and tendency for tool adhesion. Understanding how process parameters influence cutting forces is essential for improving tool life, surface quality, and process stability in these difficult-to-machine materials. This study investigates the rotary broaching of Ti6Al4V alloy to evaluate the effect of tool cutting feed on cutting forces and material deformation. The objective is to quantify the relationship between cutting feed, axial force, and equivalent plastic strain (PEEQ) during the broaching process. A combined experimental and numerical approach was employed, involving axial force measurements using a Kistler 9257BA dynamometer and finite element simulations based on the Johnson–Cook constitutive model. Cutting feeds of 5, 25, 45, 65, and 85 mm/min were tested to assess their influence on axial force behavior and plastic strain distribution. Results showed that increasing the cutting feed raised the mean axial force from approximately 2.0 kN to 2.8 kN but reduced the force fluctuations, indicating improved process stability. This reduction in fluctuation is primarily attributed to the shorter tool–workpiece contact time at higher feeds, which leads to more uniform material removal and steadier cutting action. Additionally, PEEQ values decreased with increasing feed, reflecting less extensive plastic deformation and enhanced process consistency. These findings highlight that optimizing cutting feed is crucial for achieving stable, efficient, and reliable rotary broaching of Ti6Al4V alloy.

b22e9313a8b524e4.abstract_zh: 功能梯度材料（FGM）设计通常专注于设计终端合金之间的成分路径以避免开裂。本研究开发了一种框架，通过同时改变成分和几何结构来实现所需的材料或组件级性能。为高效表征FGM组件设计的力学性能，开发了一种多材料性能表征过程，从可变宽度FGM拉伸试样中同时提取多种成分的本构行为。以Monel 400-Inconel 625（IN625）FGM拉伸试样的力学性能为例，展示了该几何和成分FGM设计框架。

b747baf260db8f0e.abstract_zh: 本文系统综述了高温材料加速测试技术的发展历程，从以阿伦尼乌斯模型和逆幂律模型为中心的经典加速因子方法，到以拉森-米勒参数为代表的时温参数方法，再到结合损伤力学的物理基础加速模型，最后到以‘定向截断’和‘统一损伤力学加速方程’为代表的新型智能加速测试范式。在此基础上，介绍了物理信息神经网络（PINN）作为连接物理模型和数据驱动方法的关键桥梁，并阐明其在损伤状态反演、小样本参数识别和载荷-寿命映射建模中的核心作用。提出了一种名为‘机制-数据-性能集成加速验证’（MDPI-AV）的综合概念框架。其核心功能通过多尺度机制建模、多源数据融合、PINN驱动的参数识别和智能测试设计的协同作用实现，从而建立高维加速应力与长期服役损伤机制之间的可信‘保真映射’。该框架的关键创新被识别为‘机制一致性保证的自适应定向截断’方法——通过多模态原位监测实时识别损伤机制，以机制一致性指数定义截断准则，并通过贝叶斯更新动态优化测试过程。此外，提出了一种‘基于统一损伤力学的加速方程’，将Lemaitre-Chaboche非线性连续损伤力学与应变范围划分（SRP）概念相结合。通过该方程，蠕变、疲劳、氧化和多场耦合效应被统一在单个内部变量演化框架内，从而根本解决了多物理场协同效应的量化挑战。MDPI-AV框架被认为代表了从‘盲目加速’到‘精确探究’的加速测试技术范式转变，为燃气轮机热端部件100,000小时以上的长寿命性能可信验证提供了系统性解决方案。

c0feb4355f1231ea.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提供了一种构建轻量化神经网络替代模型的实用指南，用于多尺度塑性模拟中的回映映射过程。我们不提出新的网络结构，而是展示如何通过一个刻意设计的前馈网络，其结构模仿经典回映映射更新，来替代传统FE 2方案中因FFT均质化在介观尺度上进行嵌套细尺度求解所带来的高昂计算成本。我们详细介绍了完整的流程：从增量均质化分析中生成训练数据，构建一个紧凑且充分的数据集，将材料对称性直接嵌入映射中，并将训练好的网络作为用户自定义材料子程序（UMAT）部署在标准有限元求解器中，从而实现广泛应用。一项敏感性研究分析了模型对数据密度、增量大小和网格细化的鲁棒性，并我们描述了替代模型适用和失效的区域。对于本文考虑的宏观各向同性、二维平面应力情况，该替代模型能够再现参考响应，同时将每项分析的成本从小时级降低到秒级，相较于标准FE 2方法速度提升高达30,000倍。此外，通过消除存储和更新大量微尺度状态变量的需要，该方法显著降低了内存需求，使得原本不可能的更精细有限元离散化成为可能。该方法在适当采样策略和数据集的支持下，可自然扩展到三维情况以及较弱的对称性假设。
c0feb4355f1231ea.title_zh: 轻量化回映映射替代模型用于多尺度塑性：实用指南
c0feb4355f1231ea.tldr: 针对多尺度塑性模拟中的回映映射过程，提出轻量化神经网络替代模型，通过简化结构降低计算成本，实现每分析从小时级到秒级的提升。

c185930b62c6a660.abstract_zh: 在Split Hopkinson Tension Bar (SHTB)试验中，自由切削钢50SiB8在高应变和高温下表现出断裂应变与温度之间的非线性关系，这是由于蓝脆效应所致。建议使用四次多项式函数来描述原始和修正Johnson-Cook (JC)断裂应变本构方程中的热部分，并识别相应的参数。文献中尚未报道50SiB8的断裂建模。使用光滑和带缺口的拉伸试样，在准静态、等温、高温和高应变率条件下对50SiB8进行表征。为了计算原始和修正JC断裂参数，分别进行了两种不同的参数识别方法，即正向和反向参数识别方法，并进行了比较和详细解释。对于原始和修正JC断裂模型的应力三轴度因子，建议使用正向参数识别方法用于原始JC断裂模型，而提出使用反向参数识别方法用于修正JC断裂模型。还展示了蓝脆效应对温度因子及其参数的影响。此外，将原始和基于蓝脆效应的JC断裂模型的有限元模拟结果与实验进行比较。在蓝脆温度范围内，新的调整JC模型在断裂直径和应变方面表现出更准确的结果。此外，本工作引入了一个结合Bai-Wierzbicki应力三轴度依赖模型、JC断裂模型和非线性温度因子的断裂模型，同时考虑蓝脆效应，但需要进一步实验以确定其参数。
c185930b62c6a660.title_zh: 自由切削钢50SiB8原始和修正Johnson-Cook断裂应变参数的两种识别方法分析
c185930b62c6a660.tldr: 通过SHTB试验分析自由切削钢50SiB8在高温和高应变下的断裂应变与温度的非线性关系，并提出结合蓝脆效应的断裂模型。

c64c685a78f1bfb8.abstract_zh: 本文研究了6082-T6铝合金板在不同后时效条件下的力学性能、变形行为和断裂特性，采用拉伸试验结合数字图像相关技术（DIC）进行分析。后时效处理在100、200、300和400 °C温度下进行，每个温度下保持时间分别为30、60和90分钟。从拉伸试验中确定了屈服强度、抗拉强度、应变硬化指数、均匀延伸率、总延伸率和能量吸收能力等参数。采用光学显微镜（OM）和扫描电子显微镜（SEM）进行微观结构和断裂分析，X射线衍射（XRD）用于评估与相相关的结构变化。硬度变化通过维氏硬度测试（HV5）进行评估。断裂表面的凹坑形态通过平均凹坑直径和标准差值进行定量评估，以分析温度和时间对断裂行为的影响。结果表明，在200 °C时效60分钟时，6082-T6铝合金表现出高度有利的强度-延展性平衡，并被确定为综合力学响应最有效的加工条件，其屈服强度约为289 MPa，抗拉强度约400 MPa，均匀延伸率15.9%，总延伸率17.4%，硬度115.6 HV，能量吸收能力61.36 MJ/m³。在300–400 °C时效时，由于析出相粗化降低了析出强化效果，出现了明显的过时效现象，导致力学性能显著退化。应变硬化响应和能量吸收能力被发现强烈依赖于时效条件。结果表明，随着时效温度升高，变形行为从相对均匀变形转变为应变局部化行为，这与高温下变形稳定性降低一致。总体而言，这些发现表明可控的后时效可以调节AA6082-T6板的强度-延展性平衡和断裂响应。
c64c685a78f1bfb8.title_zh: 6082-T6铝合金在时效后的微观结构、力学性能和韧性断裂特性研究
c64c685a78f1bfb8.tldr: 研究6082-T6铝合金在不同后时效条件下的力学性能、变形行为和断裂特性，通过拉伸试验和DIC技术分析。

c679e147e39907b9.abstract_zh: Despite their great potential for lightweight impact protection, the yield behavior of lattice materials under general stress states is complicated by factors such as loading orientation, hydrostatic stress, and strain rate, and a unified description has yet to be developed. Also, initial yield strength was commonly used to describe the yield surface of materials; however, it may be inaccurate for lattice materials and other cellular-based materials because of the presence of geometric nonlinearities (e.g., local strut buckling) and stochastic imperfections in manufacturing (like cell-wall thickness variations and nodal connectivity defects). Therefore, this work investigated the rate-dependent yielding and post-yield deformation behavior of lattice materials under dynamic loading. Body-centered cubic (BCC) lattice materials with four orientation angles (α = 0°, 15°, 30°, and 45°) were printed using 316L stainless steel. Quasi-static and dynamic compression tests were conducted, and finite element (FE) models were established and validated. During the long-stroke deformation of lattice materials, plateau stress reflects the steady-state performance of the whole sample and would be a more reliable metric for lattice's effective "yield strength" than a transient initial peak. Therefore, plateau stress was employed as the characteristic strength for yield-surface construction. The Hill 48 yield formulation was generalized by incorporating hydrostatic stress dependence and strain-rate sensitivity of plateau strength over a wide loading-rate range. Further, the post-yield collapse deformation and energy absorption of lattice materials were analyzed. The proposed model is able to capture the orientation-dependent collapse behavior and rate-induced strengthening while preserving a consistent yield-surface shape. The results elucidate the connection between hydrostatic-sensitive, rate-dependent yielding and energy absorption, providing guidance for the design of lattice materials with tailored performance.
c679e147e39907b9.title_zh: 不同胞体取向的晶格材料在动态载荷下的屈服与屈服后行为研究
c679e147e39907b9.tldr: 对不同取向的晶格材料，通过动态压缩试验和有限元分析研究其屈服及屈服后变形行为，提出基于平台应力的模型。

c69d4e29b8d9f15b.abstract_zh: To improve the manufacturing efficiency and dimensional accuracy of aerospace TC4 alloy sheet components, an in-situ resistance heating and ultrasonic vibration-assisted V-bending (RHUAV) composite forming process was developed. Increasing vibration amplitude enhances acoustic softening and reduces forming force and springback, whereas increasing ultrasonic frequency weakens these effects because of ultrasonic energy attenuation. More importantly, a thermo-ultrasonic microstructure-regulation mechanism is revealed, linking phase transformation, grain rotation, and dislocation redistribution to improved deformation coordination. This coupled regulation promotes dynamic recrystallization and grain refinement during RHUAV forming. Based on these mechanisms, a dislocation-density-based unified constitutive model and a process parameter–forming effect mapping model were established to predict dislocation evolution, flow behavior, forming force, and springback, with prediction errors below 4%. Engineering validation was performed using the base plate of an aero-engine flow path plate. Compared with conventional isothermal forming, RHUAV reduced the short- and long-side springback ratios by 63.3% and 77.8%, increased impact toughness by 19.3%, and improved manufacturing efficiency by 80.2%, while also refining the microstructure and improving surface quality. These results demonstrate that RHUAV provides an efficient route for integrated shape–property control of aerospace titanium alloy sheet components.

ca4f37f21316f55c.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种实验高效的基于人工神经网络（ANN）的框架，用于表征AA6022-T4的各向异性，并从单次孔扩张（HE）实验中校准Yld2004-18p各向异性屈服函数。该框架利用HE实验中产生的异质变形场，训练数据来自使用随机分配Yld2004-18p参数进行有限元（FE）模拟的结果。开发了两种不同的ANN框架：一种预测各向异性参数（应力比和r值），另一种直接估计Yld2004-18p参数。探讨了三种ANN输入选择策略，即使用HE模拟中21个提取位置的所有应变分量、基于局部应力的选择和基于方差的方法。在晶体塑性方法中，仅基于测量的初始晶体学织构进行的CPFEM和ΔEVPSC模拟提供了虚拟的单轴和等双轴响应，随后拟合到Yld2004-18p屈服函数。比较评估表明，ANN框架以及基于CPFEM和ΔEVPSC的方法在再现材料的各向异性响应、屈服轨迹和HE减薄曲线方面与实验和传统校准方法总体一致，同时显著减少了实验时间、成本和材料消耗。

ce6adcbbf22adf24.abstract_zh: 准确识别本构参数对于可靠模拟金属板成形过程至关重要。传统逆向识别技术，如有限元模型更新（FEMU），通常需要涉及大量有限元模拟的迭代优化过程，导致计算成本高。本文提出了一种基于双向长短期记忆（Bi-LSTM）神经网络的机器学习框架，用于从定制设计的反向弯曲试验中识别组合等向-随动强化参数。通过Sobol采样系统地变化Swift等向强化定律和Armstrong–Frederick随动强化定律的参数，生成了包含5000个有限元模拟的合成数据集。利用得到的力-位移历史训练Bi-LSTM网络，直接从力-位移响应中预测五个本构参数（K、σ0、n、C和γ）。为提高预测的物理可接受性，在训练过程中引入了物理约束损失函数，通过惩罚随动强化参数的负值来约束参数范围。所提出的模型在等向和随动强化参数上的决定系数R2超过0.98，将物理不可接受的预测案例从约30个减少到仅一个。在DP500和DP780先进高强度钢上进行了实验验证，使用Bi-LSTM预测的参数进行有限元模拟，其回弹角与实验测量值高度一致。该方法在训练后可实现近实时的本构参数识别，无需计算成本高昂的迭代优化，同时保持高预测精度和物理一致性。

d6e089ec0ca0c007.abstract_zh: 断裂是辊弯成型过程中最常见的缺陷之一。然而，可以通过多种工艺策略来减少其发生。本文研究了AA3105铝合金板在柔性辊弯成型（FRF）过程中的断裂机制，重点探讨减少损伤和防止失效的方法。进行了实验测试以确定板材的力学性能并校准改进的Mohr–Coulomb断裂准则。采用数字图像相关技术测量断裂开始时的实验应变场。随后对校准测试进行了有限元模拟，验证断裂准则，结果显示与实验结果高度一致。校准完成后，在ABAQUS中模拟了FRF过程，并实现了一个用户子程序以预测成型过程中的断裂演化。模拟结果与从FRF机器获得的实验数据对比，证实了模型的准确性。结果表明，将板材厚度从0.5 mm增加到1.5 mm，使关键单元的损伤增加了约52%；而将过渡半径从250 mm增加到550 mm以及弯曲半径从1 mm增加到3 mm，分别使损伤减少了约28%和13%。此外，增加成型工位数量使损伤减少了约10%。这些发现表明，较薄的板材和多阶段成型显著提高了铝板的成形性并降低了断裂风险。

db20c4cc67431336.abstract_zh: 本工作对钛、铁、铜和锡在高应变率压缩下的动态压缩响应进行了研究，探讨了绝热加热和应变率的影响。高应变率试验使用Split Hopkinson Pressure Bar (SHPB)进行，低应变率试验使用伺服液压试验机。在变形过程中，使用高速红外热成像技术测量试样的温度升高。结果表明，所有研究材料均表现出正的应变率敏感性，在高应变率实验（500–3100 s−1）中观察到最高达65 °C的温度升高。所有研究材料的绝热加热程度均随应变率增加。在应变率为1 s−1时，温度升高明显降低了铁和钛的应变硬化率，但似乎不足以影响铜和锡的力学行为。泰勒-金尼系数（βint和βdiff）被发现与应变和应变率有关。在较高应变率（1200–3100 s−1）下，测试初期的积分βint值较小（0.2到0.7），随着较大塑性应变增加到约0.8–0.9。微分βdiff作为应变函数呈现高斯曲线，其最大值在研究材料中为0.9到1.2。锡在较高应变硬化率下表现出较低的βint和βdiff，而铜在整个高应变率试验中表现出较高的βint和βdiff。这些结果表明，铜在变形过程中具有更稳定的微观结构，将大部分塑性功转化为热量，而锡具有更快演化的微观结构，在塑性变形过程中其微观结构储存了更多的塑性功。此外，这表明βint和βdiff可用于研究材料在高应变率塑性变形下的稳定性及微观结构演化。βdiff更适合描述材料的瞬时热机械行为，而βint更适合用于需要单一参数描述材料将塑性功转化为热量效率的应用。

dc1b5f6bca41b69b.abstract_zh: Uncoupled ductile damage criteria applied to processes involving non-proportional and non-monotonic loading, such as single-point incremental forming (SPIF), are commonly calibrated using standard characterization tests conducted under proportional monotonic loading. Prediction discrepancies may reflect incomplete coverage of the calibration domain or limitations of the criterion formulation. This study examines both explanations, evaluating transferability at three levels: discrimination between fractured and non-fractured configurations, preservation of their relative experimental ordering, and fracture localization. A process window for AA5754-H111, defined by wall angle and in-plane shape, comprised nine configurations spanning the transition from non-fractured to consistently fractured conditions. The Modified Mohr–Coulomb, Cockcroft–Latham, and Johnson–Cook criteria were assessed by comparing the experimental fracture results with predictions obtained from finite-element simulations validated against surface strain fields measured by digital image correlation. All three criteria predicted fracture-threshold crossing in every configuration, including non-fractured ones, and did not preserve the complete experimental ordering. Their damage maxima nevertheless lay within the fractured region in two of the three consistently fractured cases and approximately 15 mm from the crack in the third, compared with 30 mm for the equivalent-plastic-strain maximum. Nonlinear accumulation restored neither discrimination nor ordering, whereas mapping the calibrated loci as fracture forming limit curves better distinguished fractured and non-fractured configurations in principal-strain space. A joint calibration of the Modified Mohr–Coulomb criterion combining the characterization tests with fractured SPIF cases still produced mean absolute percentage errors in equivalent plastic strain at fracture of 46.1% for the characterization tests and 31.0% for the SPIF cases, indicating that adding process data did not resolve the conflict within this functional form. The conflict therefore cannot be attributed to calibration coverage alone. Process data can establish whether a common calibration exists, but their inclusion alone cannot reconcile the criterion formulation with both characterization and process histories.

e2b45a8e320d55b2.abstract_zh: 本研究通过Split Hopkinson压力杆测试，分析了100Cr6轴承钢弹芯材料在奥氏体处理（300 °C，1或5小时）和随后的低温处理（-80 °C，1小时）后的高应变率行为。通过SEM和XRD评估了显微组织、相变和晶体学参数，同时通过HV1显微硬度和Split Hopkinson压力杆测试量化了力学性能。低温处理在长时间奥氏体处理后系统性地提高了显微硬度和动态屈服强度，同时降低了应变能力。5小时奥氏体处理并低温处理的试样最大显微硬度达到780 HV1，比初始状态提高了约250%。XRD分析显示，1小时奥氏体处理加低温处理的试样最大预冲击和后冲击位错密度分别为77.86 x 10¹⁴ lines/m²和154.06 x 10¹⁴ lines/m²。总体而言，奥氏体处理后的低温处理有效优化了100Cr6钢的动态力学响应。

e68a54e13d296474.abstract_zh: 氢脆钢因其在高温高压条件下具有高强度、高韧性以及优异的抗氢脆性能，是先进武器系统和核物理实验中核心部件的重要工程材料。在本研究中，采用高温Split Hopkinson压力棒（SHPB）系统对氢脆钢的动态力学响应进行表征。在不同应变、应变率和变形温度下获得了真实应力-应变曲线。结果表明，真实应力表现出非线性应变硬化行为，而热软化导致其随变形温度升高而降低。通过考虑比热容的温度依赖性，计算了塑性变形过程中的绝热温升。随后确定了实际变形温度，并利用热软化系数将非等温条件下的真实应力-应变曲线校正为等温条件下的真实应力-应变曲线。基于校正后的等温真实应力-应变曲线，建立了氢脆钢的Power-Law和Johnson-Cook本构模型。这些模型通过二维切削模拟进行了拟合和评估。它们能够捕捉测试条件下的主要切削力趋势，尽管在高速切削时存在偏差。因此，这些模型可能在所研究范围内作为现象学输入用于初步切削模拟。

e833127f80b59e8b.abstract_zh: 用于安全、国防、运输和关键基础设施的玻璃必须提供清晰的视野同时可靠地抵御弹道威胁。传统浮法玻璃因其光学清晰度和压缩强度而具有吸引力，但其固有的脆性导致在高速冲击下突然开裂、碎片化和后表面剥落。因此，浮法玻璃无法承受手枪弹道载荷。由多层玻璃和聚合物夹层组成的夹层玻璃已成为解决方案。本研究在LS-DYNA R13中开发了一个模拟模型，用于评估两种夹层玻璃配置的弹道性能：一种是三层夹层玻璃，夹层为聚氨酯（PU）（S1）；另一种是双层夹层玻璃，夹层为PU，后表面为聚碳酸酯（S2）。浮法玻璃层采用Johnson–Holmquist陶瓷模型（MAT_110）以捕捉脆性断裂，而聚碳酸酯和PU夹层采用MAT_24模型模拟应变率塑性。9 mm Luger全金属被甲（FMJ）弹丸采用Johnson–Cook塑性模型定义，边界条件、冲击速度和射击间距与实验装置匹配。模拟再现了实验中观察到的关键失效机制，包括开裂、碎片化和后表面剥落。模拟结果表明，双层夹层玻璃（S2）在后表面覆盖聚碳酸酯的情况下成功阻止了弹丸，残余速度为0 m/s，表现出局部聚碳酸酯膨胀，吸收并分散冲击能量，相比之下，三层夹层玻璃（S1）经历了完全穿透。

e944ddf5b6aeafd6.abstract_zh: 温度和应变率对可锻铸铁在高温服役条件下的热机械行为和结构完整性产生深远影响。本研究在25至850 °C温度范围和1.8 × 10⁻⁴、9 × 10⁻⁴和4.5 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹应变率下进行了实验研究。拉伸试验表明，随着温度升高，抗拉强度显著下降，从室温下的761.5 MPa降至850 °C时低于100 MPa，而断裂应变增加至最大2.2%，表明高温下延性增强。通过实验验证的XFEM模拟评估了断裂韧性，结果显示其从室温下的54.66 kJ/m²降至850 °C时的23.9 kJ/m²。为建立加工条件与力学性能之间的预测关系，对Arrhenius型和Johnson–Cook本构模型进行了校准和系统比较。Johnson–Cook模型表现出显著更强的预测能力，其抗拉强度和屈服强度的决定系数R²分别为0.91和0.92，而Arrhenius模型的R²值低于0.52。基于校验的本构框架，开发了一种基于非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）的多目标优化策略，以同时优化强度、延性和断裂韧性。所得帕累托前沿量化了竞争力学性能之间的内在权衡，并实现了最优热机械加工窗口的识别。所提出的集成实验-计算框架为可锻铸铁在严苛热机械环境下的本构表征、性能预测和材料设计优化提供了验证的方法。研究结果表明，结合本构建模、断裂力学和进化多目标优化，有助于加速高性能工程合金的开发。

ec136b74e3c0a9c4.abstract_zh: 先进高强钢的孔扩展比（HER）由内在边延性（HER0）和冲孔诱导的退化（ΔHER）共同决定。然而，由于交互变量的影响和严重变形的局部区域，直接量化冲孔效应较为困难。本研究将HER解耦为内在边延性（HER0，定义为电火花加工孔的HER）和冲孔诱导的HER退化（ΔHER，定义为HER0到冲孔孔HER的相对降低），并建立了更简单的替代指标来表征这两个贡献。通过单轴拉伸和剪切试验分别获取HER0和ΔHER。有限元模拟显示，冲孔过程和剪切试验在局部变形区域表现出相似的低应力三轴度变形状态。微观硬度分析证实了两种过程的工作硬化行为相似。该框架通过两种具有相同化学成分但不同轧制减缩比的热轧马氏体钢进行了实验验证。值得注意的是，HER0较高的钢由于较大的ΔHER表现出较低的冲孔孔HER，表明ΔHER可以逆转HER性能。微观结构分析表明，原始奥氏体晶粒尺寸影响碳化物析出，导致HER0和ΔHER趋势相反。最后，一个基于机器学习的两阶段HER预测模型，结合单轴拉伸和剪切试验得到的参数，准确预测了HER0和HER，取得了高R²值。这些结果建立了一个基于替代试验的框架，通过分别考虑材料的固有响应和工艺诱导的孔边缘条件来预测HER。
ec136b74e3c0a9c4.title_zh: 基于微观结构信息的先进高强钢孔扩展行为解耦与机器学习预测
ec136b74e3c0a9c4.tldr: 通过解耦孔扩展行为的内在边延性和冲孔诱导的退化，结合机器学习方法预测先进高强钢的孔扩展性能。

ec2e08c3a2097e28.abstract_zh: 激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）技术能够制造具有可调控显微组织的钛合金，从而实现性能的定制化。本研究在不同制造条件下对Ti-20Nb-6Ta合金进行了加工。体积能量密度（VED）范围为66.1至175.8 J/mm³，扫描方向为双向，旋转角度为0°和90°。光学显微镜显示，根据 hatch 间距，熔池形态和轨迹相互作用效应存在显著差异，较高能量密度下观察到几何连续性降低。X射线衍射（XRD）结合Rietveld精修表明，显微组织主要为正交α″-Ti马氏体（72.9-90.7 wt.%），少量为α′-Ti马氏体（3.8-16.9 wt.%）和保留的β-Ti（4.0-10.2 wt.%）。电子背散射衍射（EBSD）分析显示，低能量条件（VED66/ROT90）具有最高的低角晶界比例（35.8%），表明存在显著的马氏体亚结构。相反，高能量条件（VED175/ROT90）表现出较低的低角晶界比例（约6%）和较高的高角晶界比例。极图分析显示高能量条件下具有更明确的晶体学织构。β母相的重建确认了这种各向异性来源于固相控制的β织构，并通过β-Ti → α″-Ti马氏体转变过程中的取向继承传递到马氏体结构中。压缩试验显示，随着VED增加，表观弹性模量从9.6增加至17.5 ± 2.1 GPa，压缩屈服强度从647 ± 53增加至818 ± 42 MPa。类似地，维氏硬度从约208增加至263 ± 29 HV 0.1。这些性能提升与Rietveld精修和EBSD揭示的相组成和晶体学织构演变相关。在磷酸盐缓冲盐水（PBS）溶液中的电化学测试显示，所有加工条件下均表现出稳定的被动行为，具有相似的被动电流密度，且在3 V相对于Ag/AgCl电极下未观察到局部腐蚀现象。这些结果表明，尽管观察到显微组织的变化，所研究的LPBF加工条件仍表现出相似的被动电化学行为。

ef1b86d23f21d8f2.abstract_zh: 轻质合金在强度-延展性协同方面具有重要价值，而纳米结构钛（Ti）合金是极具前景的候选材料。然而，制造具有复杂几何形状的块体组件并保持其纳米结构和优异力学性能仍具挑战。本文报告了一种通过激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）技术制造的超强Ti合金，其成分和工艺参数通过高通量实验和机器学习方法进行优化。该方法在以前未被探索的成分-工艺参数范围内，形成了由亚10纳米堆垛带驱动的微观结构。这种纳米结构使Ti合金具有约1.5 GPa的屈服强度、超过1.7 GPa的抗拉强度、约7.5%的均匀延伸率以及约380 MPa cm³ g⁻¹的比强度。开发的Ti合金结合了高强度、延展性和可扩展制造能力，为结构应用提供了有前景的性能组合。将激光粉末床熔融与高通量筛选和机器学习方法相结合，确定了制造具有亚10纳米堆垛带的Ti合金的工艺-成分范围，这些堆垛带表现出高比强度和可扩展制造的潜力。

f11fa352cdcec9cc.abstract_zh: 本文通过实验和数值方法研究了应变速率对高强Hardox 450钢摩擦行为的影响。采用环压测试方法，在从准静态（0.005 s⁻¹）到动态条件（3 000 s⁻¹）的广泛应变速率范围内识别摩擦系数。实验在干摩擦和MoS₂润滑条件下进行。结果表明，随着应变速率的增加，摩擦系数显著降低；对于干摩擦，摩擦系数从0.176降至0.015。观察到在高应变速率（1 000 s⁻¹）下，干摩擦和润滑条件下的摩擦系数趋于一致，表明润滑剂的影响变得可以忽略，而应变速率本身成为主导因素。材料的流动应力通过校准的Johnson-Cook本构模型进行表征。基于实验数据，提出了一种新的显式数学函数，描述摩擦与应变速率之间的非线性依赖关系。该模型随后通过有限元方法进行验证，显示出预测结果与实验变形环形状高度一致。

f33cb0ecb3f5b78c.tldr: 研究应变率、温度和微观结构对(CoCrNi)94Al3Ti3中熵合金力学性能的影响，并建立其本构模型。

f377af0f16ee180f.abstract_zh: 22MnB5硼钢热成形能够制造高强度汽车部件，但在几何受限区域如侧壁-底角过渡区可能发生局部变形和损伤。开发了一个热机械耦合的DEFORM-3D有限元模型，用于研究在不同模具入口温度、冲头速度和摩擦系数条件下局部温度、有效应力、有效塑性应变和损伤的变化。变形敏感区域在空间上保持稳定，但其响应幅度随工艺条件变化。增加模具入口温度（750–850）°C通过热软化降低了有效应力，对最终有效塑性应变和损伤影响较小。增加冲头速度（50–150）mm×s-1提高了温度保持性并降低了有效应力，但增加了有效塑性应变和损伤；增加摩擦系数（0.3–0.7）显著增加了有效塑性应变和损伤，对温度和应力影响有限。最终损伤与最终有效塑性应变（R²=0.99，部分反映累积NCL公式）有强相关性，但与最终有效应力（R²=0.62）相关性较弱，表明瞬时应力和累积损伤可能表现出不同的工艺依赖趋势，因此在评估局部变形和损伤累积时应联合考虑。
f377af0f16ee180f.title_zh: 热机械与损伤演化在22MnB5钢热成形过程中侧壁-底角过渡区的行为
f377af0f16ee180f.tldr: 研究22MnB5钢热成形过程中侧壁-底角过渡区的热机械行为和损伤演化，通过DEFORM-3D模型分析不同工艺参数的影响。

f8af0ffafd56dfad.abstract_zh: This study presents an entropy-based framework for segmenting and characterizing the deformation behavior of AZ31B magnesium alloy sheets using acoustic emission (AE) signals obtained during tensile and V-bending tests. Shannon entropy was calculated from four AE parameters (duration, count, signal energy, and frequency centroid). The entropy values were normalized and averaged to identify transitions between deformation stages. Individual AE waveforms were transformed into normalized time–frequency images using the continuous wavelet transform (CWT), and quantitative features extracted from these images were used for Random Forest classification of the entropy-defined stages. Internal five-fold cross-validation yielded accuracies of 94.6% and 96.42% for tensile and V-bending deformation, respectively, indicating that the stages were distinguishable in the CWT-based feature space. Hierarchical density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (HDBSCAN) separated fracture-associated AE signals during tensile deformation. The results indicate that the proposed method can characterize deformation-stage evolution and provide additional information on fracture-associated AE responses in AZ31B sheets.

fbbae036f0dddf5f.abstract_zh: In this study, the hot deformation behavior of a low-carbon bainitic steel is systematically examined within a temperature range of 1073–1373 K (800–1100 °C) and for strain rates from 0.01 to 10 s − 1 using isothermal uniaxial compression testing. Commonly-used constitutive models typically assume constant material parameters during deformation; however, material constants can vary during deformation. To address this, a modified hyperbolic sine constitutive model is implemented to more accurately predict flow stress behavior under varying thermo-mechanical conditions. The modified model exhibited strong predictive capability with experimental data, achieving a low average absolute relative error of approximately 5% and a correlation coefficient of 0.98. Activation energy analysis revealed a clear temperature dependence, with activation energy decreasing at higher temperatures due to enhanced dislocation mobility. The activation energy was also shown to progressively decrease with increasing strain, due to dynamic recrystallization mechanisms. Processing maps were developed for different strain levels based on the dynamic materials model, revealing the effect of strain on instability zones. The optimal hot deformation conditions were identified to be in the range of 1250–1350 K (977–1077 °C) at 0.02 to 0.12 s − 1 , to facilitate dynamic recrystallization, leading to formation of a uniformly refined prior austenite grain microstructure.
fbbae036f0dddf5f.title_zh: 修正的本构方法用于低碳贝氏体钢流动应力、激活能演化及加工图研究
fbbae036f0dddf5f.tldr: 基于热机械条件，修正低碳贝氏体钢的本构模型以更准确预测流动应力和激活能演化。

fdac561cbb51b69a.abstract_zh: Abstract Body-centered cubic (BCC) metals often exhibit limited ductility at finite temperatures, and elemental synergy in multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs) offers a promising route to overcome this limitation. Here, we employ atomistic simulations with a high fidelity machine-learning potential—which outperforms traditional empirical potentials at capturing complex chemical interactions—to investigate mode-I crack propagation in the engineering-relevant NbMoTaW MPEA versus pure Mo. While Mo fails by brittle cleavage, the NbMoTaW undergoes ductile fracture mediated by dislocation activity. We demonstrate that the average-based Rice criterion demands local corrections to sample diverse chemical environments along the advancing crack. Specifically, the MPEA's intrinsic chemo-mechanical heterogeneity produces atomic-scale stress delocalization at the crack tip, generating a chemically-driven shielding effect that mitigates the singular stress concentration responsible for cleavage. In particular, Ta-related local chemical heterogeneities act as precursors that nucleate localized shear and dissipate plastic energy. By embedding such heterogeneities into a brittle Mo matrix, we demonstrate that a sufficient level of interconnectivity is required to amplify stress delocalization and promote dislocation nucleation, enabling a brittle-to-ductile transition of the fracture mode. These findings reveal a stress delocalization mechanism by which local chemical heterogeneities control intrinsic ductility in BCC alloys and provide a theoretical guide for composition design.
fdac561cbb51b69a.title_zh: 局部化学异质性诱导的原子尺度应力去局域化调控BCC多主元合金的脆-韧转变
fdac561cbb51b69a.tldr: 通过高保真机器学习势能函数研究NbMoTaW多主元合金与纯钼在模式I裂纹扩展中的行为，发现化学异质性诱导的应力去局域化调控了脆-韧转变。
